book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Yesu la Sakius beeng
Yesu la eivek Jeriko me di la.
Tambiy ti mindei inyon e lei Sakius. Moxo lei ngandoung wei xel wei mi qou takis o, me tambiy on lulul ana.
Moxo embei gyei bei Yesu yon nambei nya. Ekom moxo sepika om se teyeimbei gyei, en inye moux alis vex ngenongakes.
Om moxo veimya me la tax wou sakwaing wei Yesu embei na nox me lek xax basounghek ti en embei gyei e.
Ka Yesu la paviy xax qes eno veilma lek me neil embei, “Sakius, ouk me lam daing, en ambei na mendei eivek wa bam gweimbeeng.”
Om moxo ouk me lam daing me qou e is xeilala.
Xomaxoneing dalus wei yei inyon eno xel ngoung wouma me neil embei, “Moxo la dei is xel wei sewokeing o.”

Kalekom Sakius nale me neil wou Tambiy Ngandoung, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wei! Tyek a dembu lul wei ay eno na yuw de na bong veweeng wou xel kanyo. De wangwei a qou xelti xe lulti en tyonyeing on tyek a bong malew nox zeyi wou e lu vey.”
Yesu neil wou e bei, “Gweimbeeng Anutu vind xel wei xomek tine yo veil nilul, en nambei tambiy tine inye Apraham neu is.
En Xomaxoneing Neu Moux lam en embei gyimexe me devind moux alis vex wei lati yo noumenam.”
Qayeeng pakeing wei xukxe xoumeeng qou malew o
Ka xomaxoneing ngo tiyon, Yesu neil qayeeng pakeing tine no is wou xel, en nambei la paviy Yerusalem, om xel wou naleind bei Anutu xe tete lalei tyek nam atyip daing.
Moxo neil embei, “Tambiy wei lei ngandoung eno neu ti la tembuing wei dingta yo, en embei xel balax embo king de woyom e noumenam beyeeng.
Om moxo taxe e xe xukxe xoumeeng me wong malew ghol
titi wou xel, de neil embei, ‘Xam mendi bong vateivek lek malew on deka a noum le.’
“Ekom xel wei e beeng qes eno laleind wo nol wou e, me wong xel wei xel beyal o valu betiy e me la neil embei, ‘Xa bei tambiy tiyon e se bong xa xe king.’
“Ekom e wo king, me loumelam beyeeng. Woyom moxo wo qayeeng la wou xel xukxe wei wong malew wou xel o, en embei gyei bei xel titi wong xuk lek me qou malew vamva is lek mapu.
“Tambiy tiwei myaxeeng o lam me neil, ‘Teiv, a wong xuk lek wa xe malew ghol tiwei yo me na qou malew ghol xoumeeng is.’
“De moxo neil wou bei, ‘Wang on a xe xukxe nimza me wang wo xuk nimza. Wang weiteyei lul wei nayak o, om tyek wang gweiteyei beyeeng ngandoung xoumeeng.’
“Xukxe nge wei yayuw eno lam neil embei, ‘Teiv, a wong xuk lek wa xe malew ghol tiwei yo me na qou malew ghol lim is.’
“E xe teiv lewexe, ‘Nimza, wang gweiteyei beyeeng ngandoung lim.’
“Woyom xukxe nge lam, me neil embei, ‘Teiv, wa xe malew ghol tiyo inye, a toung eivek qaeing myasepu ti.
En a xaleeng en wang, en wa tambiy wei niseikeing o, wang mi qou vati wei wa seng toung o, me wang mi qou lul yaeing wei wa seng ev o.’

“Woyom king neil wou e xe xukxe, ‘Wa xukxe nilul. Tyek a bong qayeeng en wang en wamaxow xe qayeeng. Wang wei bei a tambiy wei niseikeing, a mi qou vati wei a se toung me na qou lulul yaeing wei a se ev o?
Nambei nya wa seng toung axe malew eivek xomek malew, en kandek gyeik ingwei a noum ond a qou is malew wei xel toung lek mapu yo?’
“Woyom king neil wou xel wei toukale paviy e yo, ‘Xam qou malew ghol tiyon veil e me wong wou tambiy wei e xe malew ghol xoumeeng o.’
“Xel neil wou e, ‘Teiv, xukxe yon qou malew ghol xoumeeng woy!’
“Moxo neil elox, ‘A neil wou xam, xel eti yeiw wei qou lulul, eno tyek am bong valu is wou xel, ekom wangwei xelti se qou lulul ti, on lul nayak kawei toundei wou e yon, tyek am bouveil e.
Ekom xel vevek amba wei ay yo embei a se bong king wei xel, eno xam a qou xel me ghe nam inye me ghe nyeis xel amey wou a mang.’”
Yesu la eivek Yerusalem nambei king
Ka Yesu neil qayeeng on woy, om betiwou sakwaing me lek me la Yerusalem.
Ka Yesu la paviy Betpage me Betani lek qetyei wei xel mi neil embei lukendu Oliv, eno moxo wong e xe xel betiyeing yayuw la me neil wou luw,
“Muw ghe na eivek beyeeng tinei, wangwei muw ghe na, tyek muw ghe gwei dongi lingheing ti xel qoxoun nanghei inyon, xelti seng ghei dei lek. Muw a tul me na qou me ghe nam inye.
Wangwei xelti teling muw, ‘Muw ghe tul dongi yon enva?’ On muw a neil wou e bei, ‘Tambiy Ngandoung embei bong xuk en.’”
Betiyeing yuw wei wong luw la eno luw yei lul nambei ingwei e neil wou luw o.
Ka luw di tul yis veil dongi eno mayeiw teling wou luw bei, “Muw ghe tul dongi ne enva?”
Luw neil elox bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung embei bong xuk en.”
Om luw qou dongi me la wou Yesu. Xel toung xel xe teimb lek dongi demi de toung Yesu la dei lek.
Ka e di la, eno xomaxoneing liw xel xe teimb me teteyexe wou sakwaing.

Gyeik ingwei moxo la paviy beyeeng wei sakwaing lep me la lukendu Oliv nei, eno e xe xel betiyeing ngenongakes di wong xeindlala me sanghoxe Anutu me wo denduing en lulvako wei xel yei woy o. Xel neil,

content.text: “Mata ena wou king tiwei lam lek Tambiy Ngandoung lei yo!” Qapiya Lalo 118:26
“Lalei vevopeing e gyeip senghoing eivek Anutu wei tyoung gheyapu nei me xey de lei laeing ena wou Anutu.”

content: De xel Parisi valu toundei eivek xel ngenong on lalei, xel neil wou Yesu bei, “Putoung, wa neil wa xe xel betiyeing on, en xel se neil qayeeng on.”
Yesu neil wou xel, “A neil wou xam! Wangwei xel mendei kanzek, on tyek xel qakous ne taxe xoulekeing.”
Yesu eng en Yerusalem
Ka Yesu la paviy Yerusalem me yei beyeeng ngandoung on, eno moxo eng en.
Me neil embei, “Wangwei wamaxow ghe boulek bouk tine, en sakwaing wei lalei vevopeing lam wou wang ne, ekom gweimbeeng xupek en wa mam.
Bouk ti tyek nam, gyeik wa xe xel vevek nam a poux tembuing apup me bivekwou tete wei wang on. Me tyek xel bale ebivekwou danghei danghei nei zeyi wang.

Tyek xel lelolexe wang na lek tembuing, wang is neumyeiw wei toundei eivek wang on. Tyek xel se bong qakous nge na toumendei lek nge mapu, en nambei wa seng woulek bouk wei Anutu lam en embei devind wang o.”
Yesu tiy xel veil xomek vambuing
Woyom Yesu la eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o me tiy xel wei di wong vateivek lek lulul o.
Moxo neil wou xel, “Xel byex eivek xoulek eno nambei nye, ‘Axe xomek ne, inye xomek wei zeimeing mema eivek o.’
Ekom xam ghe wong e wong ambei ‘beyeeng xupekeing wei xel panaxeing o.’
Taxombouk eno Yesu mi teyoxe xel eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o. Ekom xel lumuki leitata yo, me putoung wei petieing o me gyovaxa wei xomaxoneing o, di wong me yei en xel embei nyeis e mey.
Ekom xel se yeiwou sakwaing ti, en nambei xomaxoneing wei toundei me ngo e xe qayeeng eno wo nikanzek.

footnotes.text: Ghol malew wei tambiy wei lei ngandoung eno neu toung eivek e xe xukxe titi memend, inye nambei xouveing wei dentouk qes yal o.
